record.bible_text: Now gather<WH01413><WTH8704> thyself in troops<WH01416>, O daughter<WH01323> of troops<WH01416>: he hath laid<WH07760><WTH8804> siege<WH04692> against us: they shall smite<WH05221><WTH8686> the judge<WH08199><WTH8802> of Israel<WH03478> with a rod<WH07626> upon the cheek<WH03895>.

But thou, Bethlehem<WH01035> Ephratah<WH0672>, <FI>though<Fi> thou be little<WH06810> among the thousands<WH0505> of Judah<WH03063>, <FI>yet<Fi> out of thee shall he come forth<WH03318><WTH8799> unto me <FI>that is<Fi> to be ruler<WH04910><WTH8802> in Israel<WH03478>; whose goings forth<WH04163> <FI>have been<Fi> from of old<WH06924>, from everlasting<WH03117><WH05769>. <RF>everlasting: Heb. the days of eternity<Rf>

Therefore will he give them up<WH05414><WTH8799>, until the time<WH06256> <FI>that<Fi> she which travaileth<WH03205><WTH8802> hath brought forth<WH03205><WTH8804>: then the remnant<WH03499> of his brethren<WH0251> shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>.

And he shall stand<WH05975><WTH8804> and feed<WH07462><WTH8804> in the strength<WH05797> of the LORD<WH03068>, in the majesty<WH01347> of the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> his God<WH0430>; and they shall abide<WH03427><WTH8804>: for now shall he be great<WH01431><WTH8799> unto the ends<WH0657> of the earth<WH0776>. <RF>feed or, rule<Rf>

And this <FI>man<Fi> shall be the peace<WH07965>, when the Assyrian<WH0804> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> into our land<WH0776>: and when he shall tread<WH01869><WTH8799> in our palaces<WH0759>, then shall we raise<WH06965><WTH8689> against him seven<WH07651> shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802>, and eight<WH08083> principal<WH05257> men<WH0120>. <RF>principal: Heb. princes of<Rf>

And they shall waste<WH07462><WTH8804> the land<WH0776> of Assyria<WH0804> with the sword<WH02719>, and the land<WH0776> of Nimrod<WH05248> in the entrances<WH06607> thereof: thus shall he deliver<WH05337><WTH8689> <FI>us<Fi> from the Assyrian<WH0804>, when he cometh<WH0935><WTH8799> into our land<WH0776>, and when he treadeth<WH01869><WTH8799> within our borders<WH01366>. <RF>waste: Heb. eat up<Rf> <RF>in the...: or, with her own naked swords<Rf><CM>

And the remnant<WH07611> of Jacob<WH03290> shall be in the midst<WH07130> of many<WH07227> people<WH05971> as a dew<WH02919> from the LORD<WH03068>, as the showers<WH07241> upon the grass<WH06212>, that tarrieth<WH06960><WTH8762> not for man<WH0376>, nor waiteth<WH03176><WTH8762> for the sons<WH01121> of men<WH0120>.

And the remnant<WH07611> of Jacob<WH03290> shall be among the Gentiles<WH01471> in the midst<WH07130> of many<WH07227> people<WH05971> as a lion<WH0738> among the beasts<WH0929> of the forest<WH03293>, as a young lion<WH03715> among the flocks<WH05739> of sheep<WH06629>: who, if he go through<WH05674><WTH8804>, both treadeth down<WH07429><WTH8804>, and teareth in pieces<WH02963><WTH8804>, and none can deliver<WH05337><WTH8688>. <RF>sheep: or, goats<Rf>
Thine hand<WH03027> shall be lifted up<WH07311><WTH8799> upon thine adversaries<WH06862>, and all thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> shall be cut off<WH03772><WTH8735>.

And it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, that I will cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> thy horses<WH05483> out of the midst<WH07130> of thee, and I will destroy<WH06><WTH8689> thy chariots<WH04818>:
And I will cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> the cities<WH06145><WTH8676><WH05892> of thy land<WH0776>, and throw down<WH02040><WTH8804> all thy strong holds<WH04013>:
And I will cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> witchcrafts<WH03785> out of thine hand<WH03027>; and thou shalt have no <FI>more<Fi> soothsayers<WH06049><WTH8781>:

Thy graven images<WH06456> also will I cut off<WH03772><WTH8689>, and thy standing images<WH04676> out of the midst<WH07130> of thee; and thou shalt no more worship<WH07812><WTH8691> the work<WH04639> of thine hands<WH03027>. <RF>standing...: or, statues<Rf>
And I will pluck up<WH05428><WTH8804> thy groves<WH0842> out of the midst<WH07130> of thee: so will I destroy<WH08045><WTH8689> thy cities<WH06145><WTH8676><WH05892>. <RF>cities: or, enemies<Rf>
And I will execute<WH06213><WTH8804> vengeance<WH05359> in anger<WH0639> and fury<WH02534> upon the heathen<WH01471>, such as they have not heard<WH08085><WTH8804>.<CM>
